name: Crossing Graph Bounds the Cube Polynomial
statement: For every partial cube $G\ne K_1$, $C(G,x)\le\operatorname{Cl}(G^\sharp,x+1)$ coefficientwise, with equality exactly when $G$ is median. Thus for median $G$, the coefficient of $(x+1)^k$ in $C(G,x)$ equals the number of $k$-cliques of $G^\sharp$.
comments: The identity transfers clique-polynomial phenomena to cube polynomials; in particular, median cube polynomials need not be unimodal.
